Data extraction: .editorconfig INI dialect sections and settings

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "tree_sitter_language_pack"
result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("[*.rs]\nindent_style = space\nindent_size = 4\n", { 'data_extraction' => true, 'language' => 'editorconfig' })
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data.kind.inspect
puts result.data.children.inspect
```
